source_kind: exact human messages in this game chat
messages_in_order: I got an answer! The publisher says that as long as the strength of the exhausted pieces used in defense is equal to or greater than the attacking strength, the Crisis fails. Does that answer your question?
Just accept my answer. You can note it as my interpretation.
normative_authority_for_summary: User-approved interpretation: total newly exhausted defense strength equal to or greater than attack makes the Crisis fail. Attribute to user.
